text.tspan: Sex gap in life expectancy at different agesUnited Kingdom
The sex gap of female minus male life expectancy at different ages. Positive values indicate higher life
expectancy among females; negative values indicate higher life expectancy among males.
Data source: Human Mortality Database (2025); UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
